verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own recurring automation for payments: subscriptions, recurring Automatic Pix charges, and automatic dunning notifications sent before and after the due date. That is domain-specific recurring billing rather than a general way to schedule arbitrary jobs or workflows, and the evidence gives only thin mentions with no scheduling details. Missing for 10: general-purpose job/workflow scheduling, documented schedule configuration (intervals, cron-like timing), subscription API depth, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Features such as subscriptions, payment links, split, receivables anticipation, subaccounts, invoices, and Webhooks are also available.
When creating recurring Automatic Pix payments in MANUAL mode, provide the pixAutomaticAuthorizationId of an ACTIVE authorization.
Envie notificações automáticas antes e depois do vencimento.
